pairs.subject: copy-quality-gates
pairs.evidence: scripts/hooks/copy-check.sh:19 The repo's only copy gate is a pre-push hook. When the gitignored checker link is missing it exits 0, and no CI job runs copy:check, so fresh clones, CI and `--no-verify` pushes all ship copy no gate has seen. That is the fail-open single seam the technique refuses to count as enforcement.

techniques.evidence: scripts/hooks/copy-check.sh:18 The hook fails open. .github/workflows/ci.yml has no copy-check step, so no downstream seam exists that cannot fail open.
scripts/hooks/copy-check.sh:4 Legacy findings are held by a ratchet and only new errors block. Warnings are printed.
docs/i18n/copy-contract.json:5 The declared variant and mechanics were counted against the real catalog before being declared, as the technique asks.
docs/i18n/copy-contract.json:4 Coverage is recorded as a string count, not a key count. Scope is limited to the derived EN catalog.

pairs.subject: copy-quality-gates
pairs.evidence: features/landing/referendum/ReferendumPage.tsx:17 The referendum surface renders its Czech source copy as inline JSX literals. No gate sees them: hardcodedCopy.test.ts scopes only features/landing/components/, and the copy contract covers only messages/en.json. This is the user-visible literal escaping the catalog that L1 is meant to block, and the copy is neither extracted nor declared out of scope in any gate report.

techniques.evidence: features/landing/referendum/ReferendumPage.tsx:192 L1 includes 'no literal user-visible string escaping the catalog' as a blocking check. Here such literals render and nothing blocks them.

features/landing/hardcodedCopy.test.ts:15 The literal scanner's scope stops at components/, so the referendum's out-of-catalog copy is an undeclared coverage hole. The only declaration is a source comment, not a line in any gate report.
